I reviewed the labeled examples and distilled the rules below.

```json
{
  "filter_rule": {
    "include_patterns": [

      "(?i)\\b(entry|sl|tp|target|stop|тейк|стоп|вход)\\b"
    ],
    "exclude_patterns": [],
    "matched_reason_template": "distilled_filter",
    "recall_target": 0.95
  },
  "parser_rules": [
    {
      "patterns": [
        "(?i)(?P<symbol>[A-Z]{2,10})\\s+(?P<side>long|short|buy|sell|лонг|шорт)(?:.*?(?:entry|вход)[:\\s]+(?P<entry>[\\d.,]+k?))?(?:.*?(?:sl|стоп)[:\\s]+(?P<sl>[\\d.,]+k?))?(?:.*?(?:tp|тейк)[:\\s]+(?P<tp>[\\d.,]+k?))?"
      ],
      "field_map": {
        "symbol": "symbol",
        "side": "side",
        "entry": "entry",
        "sl": "stop_loss",
        "tp": "take_profit"
      },
      "side_aliases": {
        "long": "LONG",
        "buy": "LONG",
        "short": "SHORT",
        "sell": "SHORT",
        "лонг": "LONG",
        "шорт": "SHORT"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

These should hold recall on the positives while keeping precision on the fields.
